gap_closed: ConstructiveArrivalModel took (earliest, latest) as INPUT; nothing generated or verified them, so the UNDER label was an assertion.
why_unblocked: A constructive schedule needs kinematic limits and a path, not the evader policy (D08) or the capture thresholds (D06).

criteria.C2_interval_fullness: >=200 sampled times in [t_min,t_max], each integrating to exact arrival
criteria.C3_legality: 0 <= v <= v_limit and -b_max <= a <= a_max on every segment; zero violations
criteria.C4_under_is_earned: every reported time has a verified legal schedule
criteria.C5_nonconvexity: a blocking window yields >=2 disjoint intervals, each fully scheduled
criteria.C6_end_to_end: constructive sets reach SUPPORTED where free-flow sets give UNKNOWN

gate_rule.claim_supported: An UNDER-approximating arrival set can be produced and its label EARNED, in the declared finite abstraction only.

explicitly_not_established: that constructive witnesses can be produced on a real SUMO network
